limitations: Online Methods of the paper are paywalled and not in Europe PMC; the CDK inhibitor compound, dose and duration are not named in accessible text
Fragment mass tolerance is the MaxQuant default, not read from deposited parameters (search.tar.gz is 1.9 GB)
Assignment of single-shot runs as technical replicate 2 is an encoding choice for 'same sample measured single-shot and fractionated'
Passage number, culture medium and K0-SUMO construct details not captured
Pairing of control and CDKi replicate numbers (whether replicate n of each condition came from the same culture batch) is not documented
